facts.text: A voice narrates my life, even at dinner. Ana gave me cookies, so I've stopped counting and I'm just eating them.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Harold's real line after the cookies is 'The cookies were good. Thank you for forcing me to eat them.'.
facts.fix: The cookies were good. Thank you for forcing me to eat them.

facts.text: Hilbert, the literature professor who sits the lifeguard chair at the campus pool.
facts.why: In the script Hilbert tells Harold he is the faculty lifeguard at the pool, on top of teaching and mentoring.
